answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a bonded on-chain relic whose provenance is verified through asynchronous Byzantine quorum intersection, so a sybil cluster cannot certify itself without corrupting distinct quorums. A TLA+ kernel then enforces that every new wharf lease and timber shipment requires a quorum-certified state transition, making duplicate identities. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
